_comment: The set of module releases known to be good together in production.
Each module deploys from its own tag and its own version line, so a git
commit cannot express 'what is live' — this file can. Rolling the suite
back means redeploying exactly these tags.
Do not edit by hand: `scripts/suite.sh promote` writes it from what is
actually running on Fly, so it records reality rather than intention.
The `deployable` git tag points at the commit where it was last promoted.
